description: Zones d'éligibilité au Très Haut Débit et au Haut Débit Renforcé dans l'Hérault is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Répartition des zones d'éligibilité sur le territoire héraultais. Découpage entre la zone d’initiative publique (Hérault THD) et la zone d'initiative privée (opérateurs Orange et SFR). Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Territoires, Agriculture et Innovations. Its keywords are THD, ftth, fibre, tres-haut-debit, eligible. The portal shows 499 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-01-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
